purpose: Continuously reconcile canonical task lifecycle, checkout state, worker-return obligations, Master Records returns, and StegHealth recovery derivation without creating a second scheduler or task authority.

reporting_postures.ACTIVE: Nonterminal task with checked-out/current execution or an admitted continuation path.
reporting_postures.INACTIVE: Nonterminal task not currently checked out and with no current worker execution. This is a monitor posture, not a lifecycle state.
reporting_postures.COMPLETED: Primary task work is canonically complete but the task has not yet been retired.
reporting_postures.RETIRED: Canonical RETIRED task. Terminal and provenance-only.
reporting_postures.SUPERSEDED: Canonical SUPERSEDED task. Redirect-only terminal identity.
reporting_postures.INVALID: Canonical INVALID task. Fail-closed terminal identity.

symptoms.RETURN_PENDING: Worker return expectation has not yet elapsed.
symptoms.RETRYING: Worker remains within bounded retry resilience.
symptoms.RETURN_OVERDUE: Expected return window elapsed and matching Master Records return is absent.
symptoms.WORKER_NONREPORT: Independent evidence confirms the expected worker return never reached Master Records.
symptoms.HEALTHY: Expected worker return/history is present and reconciled.
